summary: one sentence: what this repo is and why it exists
overview: 2-4 short paragraphs: purpose, main flows, notable design decisions
kind: service | library | frontend | infra | job | tool | other
owners: from CODEOWNERS or similar, else empty
identifiers: every name others use to reach or import this repo: service names, hostnames, k8s service names, image names, package names

exposes.kind: http | grpc | graphql | websocket | topic | queue | event | package | database | cli | other
exposes.name: short human label, e.g. POST /orders or OrderCreated
exposes.key: exact string consumers use: hostname or service name for APIs, topic or queue name, package name
exposes.detail: one line: protocol, auth, payload, sync or async

consumes.name: short label of what is used
consumes.key: literal target found in code or config: URL host, service name, env var default, topic, package
consumes.detail: one line: why it is called, sync or async, retries

datastores.kind: postgres | mysql | dynamodb | redis | s3 | elasticsearch | other
datastores.name: database, table, bucket, or cluster name

entrypoints: repo-relative paths to main files, handlers, or job definitions
notes: uncertainties, guesses, and gaps go here, not in the lists above
